title: DIDN'T LIKE
text: DIDN'T LIKE. We sent the 2 rugs we ordered back.  We got one of them out of the box & it seemed very wrinkled.  We draped it over a single bed for a few days plus we rolled it up opposite how it came to see if the wrinkles would straighten out but they didn't.  We didn't even open the other box.

product_metadata.title: Ottomanson Dark Red Traditional Oriental Design Area Rug (5'X7') - Persian Style
features: Jute back, low pile, fade and wear resistant machine-made polypropylene. Made in Turkey.
Care instructions: Rotate periodically. Spot clean and vacuum. Do not dry clean.

Please note: While we display the most accurate color possible, there is likely to be variations in color due to differences in computer monitors as well as ambient lighting in the home. We also do our best to provide accurate measurements but there may be slight variances in width or length from the published dimensions.
description: This beautiful brand new PATERSON Collection rug with soft rich color palette offers a durable stain resistant and low pile for easy cleaning with Jute backing. Machine woven on Jacquad Looms with 100% nylon pile and manufactured in Turkey. Perfect addition to any room with it's intricate and elegant design. Care instructions: Do not rub wet spots, absorb moisture with paper towels, and remove dried spots by scraping carefully towards the center of the spot.
